Current Population Survey, Annual Social and Economic Supplement (CPS ASEC)

Current Population Survey, Annual Social and Economic Supplement (CPS ASEC)

The March supplement to the monthly Current Population Survey, conducted by the Census Bureau for the Bureau of Labor Statistics: income, poverty, work experience, health insurance and living arrangements of the US civilian noninstitutional population.

Publisher
U.S. Census Bureau (for the Bureau of Labor Statistics)
Dataset
https://www.census.gov/data/datasets/time-series/demo/cps/cps-asec.html
Terms
https://www.census.gov/about/policies.html
Allen Downey decided on 2026-11-19 that data, documentation and metadata ship and that LLM processing is allowed, with a Census Bureau credit as the notice. Users must still not try to identify any person or household. What the sources say: the public-use files are federal works (17 U.S.C. 105), and the ASEC pages state no restriction on use or redistribution. Census's terms for its data API (https://www.census.gov/data/developers/about/terms-of-service.html) carry the Title 13 obligations: don't use the data to identify any person or household, don't link it with other data to identify anyone, and report an inadvertent identification. Citation: https://www.census.gov/about/policies/citation.html.

wave
ASEC year — Each release is one ASEC year. Income, poverty and work experience refer to the calendar year before it (the 2024 ASEC asks about 2023).
